name: Reverb (on this Mac)
description: Voiceovers made offline on this Mac's GPU with Reverb, in English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Polish and Portuguese, in a preset voice or one cloned from a few seconds of speech. No key: Uncut downloads the voice model (386 MB) the first time. Reverb's weights are for non-commercial use only (CC BY-NC 4.0).
author: Uncut
